items.name: retail-sales-statistical-analysis
items.description: A comprehensive statistical deep-dive into multi-region retail performance. This project explores central tendency, dispersion, and marketing impact using Python, focusing on Cohen’s d effect sizes to differentiate between statistical significance and practical business value.

items.name: statsheet
items.description: Statistical significance engine for AI benchmarks: bootstrap confidence intervals, paired tests, effect sizes. Turns raw benchmark numbers into Model B wins by 3.2 percent plus or minus 1.1 percent (p<0.05). Extends Batcher and Green-Zone benchmark data.
